decisions.reason: As an adjacent multi-item supplement line, it is relatively cheap for a large expanding firm to carry and still preserves consumer-health portfolio value while sales evidence remains imperfect.
After several years a single skin-and-hair supplement should have revealed its market traction, and in a crowded low-differentiation niche the option value of waiting is now limited.
This joint-health supplement stays close to the firm's pharmacy-oriented consumer-health portfolio, and without a clear negative signal its low carrying cost justifies keeping it on the market.

The earlier Valsartan quality and regulatory issue is a strong adverse signal in a sensitive generic prescription category, so expected compliance and reputational costs outweigh the remaining option value.
By 2022 the OTC migraine triptan should have shown whether it merits a lasting place in the portfolio, and for a more distant product without a clear positive signal we would reallocate resources.
